root_cause.claim: hero_mana::slot refused the BattleObjectModuleAccessor, so side-B level-1/level-2 spells were never charged.
root_cause.why_silent: slot() is the only gate behind side-B spending, the meter, the HUD and recovery. On refusal begin_cast returns token 0, try_spend returns true without debiting, cast_ok returns true, and the meter is never seeded - which is exactly the mana-off build's behaviour, so a false negative reads as a free spell rather than as a bug.
root_cause.how_established: elimination plus code. No BattleObjectModuleAccessor address on this title has ever been measured here, so the window was an unverified guess. hero_side_b::state::get makes the same category/kind/colour/entry reads as slot(), makes no window check, and is measured working on c06/c07 Mythra hardware (evidence/2026-10-02_pgwr_T-0052, hardware 2026-10-02). The window was the only remaining way slot() could refuse.
root_cause.fix: address_ok is now address != 0 && address % alignment == 0. Removing the window can only admit more pointers, never fewer, so it cannot introduce a new false positive.
root_cause.tier: B by elimination and code reading; runtime effect tier D until hardware

recovery_interpretation_correction.was: hero_mana/damage.rs claimed the donor recovers MP when this fighter was hit or blocked.
recovery_interpretation_correction.now: The award is keyed on damage this fighter DEALS and shield damage this fighter TAKES.
evidence: the pinned vl.prc sha256 dafa43c6... names them sp_recover_damage_mul and sp_recover_shield_mul; a received-damage rule has no shield half to pair with

the donor csel at main+0x854a4c selects +0xc0 (damage_mul) or +0xbc (shield_mul) on one event bit; main+0x854a60 fmul s0,s8,s0 scales a damage-derived value s8 built at main+0x8549a0..0x854a3c with fighter-percentage damage scaling; main+0x854a68 bl 0x853890 passes the product to the same add_sp
main+0x854610 has zero BL callers; it is address-taken from a vtable at about main+0x3a9fc00, so its caller and its attacker/victim ABI are NOT recovered

attack_recovery.rule: one award per opponent this pair's own non-mana-costing move connects with; amount = AttackModule::get_power(hit_no) * RECOVER_DAMAGE_MUL through the owned add()
attack_recovery.trigger: fighter-attached CheckAttack line callback on both halves behind the c06/c07 costume gate; same collision table hero_side_b::fighter::store_target already reads

exclusions.mana-costing casts: they already had their price debited
exclusions.own partner and teammates: TeamModule::team_no; a friendly body must not farm the meter
exclusions.non-fighter targets: boss items and gimmicks are hit repeatedly and would stream awards
exclusions.dead/respawning: stock_spent; a stock boundary must not cross entries or matches

attack_recovery.fidelity: proportional, not the engine's final damage number, because that number is not in the collision table. A non-positive or implausible get_power read falls back to one passive-recovery unit.
attack_recovery.get_power_args: read from the locked binding, NOT measured
attack_recovery.shield_half: not built; needs the victim-side collision event, whose only site is the reserved main+0x854610 (mod rule 17, not approved)

hardware_tests_required: 1. Mythra c06, do not attack: gauge starts full and does not drift (meter seeding).
2. Side-B level 1 release on an opponent: gauge drops about 8. Level 2 (Zapple): about 18. THIS IS THE BUG.
3. Side-B from the air, levels 1 and 2: same expected drop (air release path).
4. Empty meter, hold side-B through the hold: no refill while casting; the move refuses (motion plays, no sparks or bolts).
5. Jab at about 50 MP: the gauge rises. Stand still 5 seconds: it rises by only the passive amount. Separates attack recovery from passive.
6. Land a connecting Zap: net about -8 plus a small rise, not a full refund (mana-costing casts excluded).
7. Hit a boss item or a shield without touching a fighter: the gauge does NOT rise (non-fighter exclusion).
8. Take a stock: the gauge returns to full exactly once, then holds through the respawn animation.
9. Down-B swap: the same gauge number on both halves (one meter for the pair).
10. Spot-check unchanged: Zapple angle, up-B gravity 0.70/0.70, DK cargo, Incineroar back throw, Chrom jab sword.
